name: 01 - Avatar IQ - Native Gemini + Postgres Memory

parameters.query: create extension if not exists pgcrypto; create table if not exists public.profiles (id uuid primary key references auth.users(id) on delete cascade, full_name text not null default '', avatar_url text, role text not null default 'member', created_at timestamptz not null default now(), updated_at timestamptz not null default now()); create table if not exists public.blueprint_sessions (id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(), session_id uuid not null unique, owner_id uuid not null references public.profiles(id) on delete cascade, status text not null default 'draft' check (status in ('draft','generating','completed','failed')), step integer not null default -1 check (step between -1 and 4), answers jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb, messages jsonb not null default '[]'::jsonb, draft text not null default '', selected_category text, blueprint jsonb, last_error text, created_at timestamptz not null default now(), updated_at timestamptz not null default now()); create index if not exists blueprint_sessions_owner_updated_idx on public.blueprint_sessions(owner_id, updated_at desc); grant usage on schema public to authenticated; grant select, insert, update, delete on public.blueprint_sessions to authenticated; revoke all on public.blueprint_sessions from anon; alter table public.blueprint_sessions enable row level security; do $$ begin if not exists (select 1 from pg_policies where schemaname = 'public' and tablename = 'blueprint_sessions' and policyname = 'Users own blueprint sessions') then create policy "Users own blueprint sessions" on public.blueprint_sessions for all to authenticated using ((select auth.uid()) = owner_id) with check ((select auth.uid()) = owner_id); end if; end $$; create table if not exists public.n8n_chat_histories (id bigserial primary key, session_id text not null, message jsonb not null); create index if not exists n8n_chat_histories_session_idx on public.n8n_chat_histories(session_id, id); revoke all on public.n8n_chat_histories from anon, authenticated; revoke all on sequence public.n8n_chat_histories_id_seq from anon, authenticated; alter table public.n8n_chat_histories enable row level security; select 1 as ready;

create table if not exists public.workspace_memory (owner_id uuid primary key references public.profiles(id) on delete cascade, onboarding_complete boolean not null default false, business_profile jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb, audience_profile jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb, offer_profile jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb, brand_profile jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb, creation_preferences jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb, memory_summary text not null default '', source_session_id uuid, created_at timestamptz not null default now(), updated_at timestamptz not null default now()); grant select, insert, update, delete on public.workspace_memory to authenticated; revoke all on public.workspace_memory from anon; alter table public.workspace_memory enable row level security; do $$ begin if not exists (select 1 from pg_policies where schemaname = 'public' and tablename = 'workspace_memory' and policyname = 'Users own workspace memory') then create policy "Users own workspace memory" on public.workspace_memory for all to authenticated using ((select auth.uid()) = owner_id) with check ((select auth.uid()) = owner_id); end if; end $$; select 1 as ready;
insert into public.profiles (id) values ($1::uuid) on conflict (id) do nothing returning id;
select blueprint from public.blueprint_sessions where session_id = $1::uuid and owner_id = $2::uuid limit 1;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ $('Verify User and Normalize').first().json.session_id, $('Verify User and Normalize').first().json.user_id ] }}

options.systemMessage: You are Avatar IQ, a senior ideal-buyer research strategist and direct-response copywriter. Create a commercially useful buyer blueprint from only supplied facts and defensible general market knowledge. Never invent statistics, quotes, case studies, or claims of live research. If live research is unavailable, state that in research_notes. Use concrete buyer language, distinct headline angles, and concise but substantive fields. Return only the structured output requested by the parser.

parameters.sessionKey: ={{ $('Verify User and Normalize').first().json.user_id + ':avatar:' + $('Verify User and Normalize').first().json.session_id }}

parameters.query: insert into public.blueprint_sessions (session_id, owner_id, status, step, blueprint, last_error, updated_at) values ($1::uuid, $2::uuid, 'completed', 4, $3::jsonb, null, now()) on conflict (session_id) do update set status = 'completed', step = 4, blueprint = excluded.blueprint, last_error = null, updated_at = now() where public.blueprint_sessions.owner_id = excluded.owner_id returning session_id;

insert into public.workspace_memory (owner_id, onboarding_complete, business_profile, audience_profile, memory_summary, source_session_id, updated_at) values ($1::uuid, true, $2::jsonb, $3::jsonb, $4, $5::uuid, now()) on conflict (owner_id) do update set onboarding_complete = true, business_profile = excluded.business_profile, audience_profile = excluded.audience_profile, memory_summary = excluded.memory_summary, source_session_id = excluded.source_session_id, updated_at = now() returning owner_id;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ $('Validate Buyer Blueprint').first().json.user_id, JSON.stringify({ business: $('Validate Buyer Blueprint').first().json.business, buyer: $('Validate Buyer Blueprint').first().json.buyer, problem: $('Validate Buyer Blueprint').first().json.problem, objections: $('Validate Buyer Blueprint').first().json.objections }), JSON.stringify($('Validate Buyer Blueprint').first().json.blueprint), $('Validate Buyer Blueprint').first().json.business + ' Ideal buyer: ' + $('Validate Buyer Blueprint').first().json.blueprint.persona_name, $('Validate Buyer Blueprint').first().json.session_id ] }}
